name: cygnus-trailer
description: Remotion-Trailer für den Cygnus-Spielmodus auf OneLiteFeather

scripts.music: python3 scripts/generate_music.py out/music && for f in out/music/*.wav; do remotion ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i $f -c:a libopus -b:a 160k public/music/$(basename $f .wav).ogg; done
